scripts.installation:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "Downloading RedM Server..."
mkdir -p /home/container/redm
cd /home/container/redm

# Download the latest RedM server build
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sSL https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server/redm | jq -r '.latest_download' 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ] || [ "$DOWNLOAD_URL" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Failed to get download URL"
    exit 1
fi

curl -sSL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o server.tar.gz
tar -xzf server.tar.gz
rm -f server.tar.gz run.sh

echo "RedM Server downloaded successfully!"
echo ""
echo "Next steps:"
echo "1. Set REDM_LICENSE environment variable with your server key from https://portal.cfx.re/"
echo "2. Configure txAdmin port (default: 40120) and server port (default: 30120)"
echo "3. Start the server!"

variables.name: RedM License Key
variables.description: Your RedM server license key from https://portal.cfx.re/

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically download and update RedM server binaries on startup

variables.name: txAdmin Port
variables.description: Port for the txAdmin web panel

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Main server port for RedM connections
